item.title: Mary Bono asks appeals court to overturn Cher’s win in Sonny Bono song royalties fight, arguing Cher ‘already received nearly fifty years of royalties’
item.description:
Music Business Worldwide • Legal / dispute

item.title: Viviz wins contract termination lawsuit against Big Planet Made
item.description:
Korea Herald • Contract / agency
Viviz, a girl group formed by three former GFriend members, has won a lawsuit against its former agency, Big Planet Made Entertainment, after a court ruled that unpaid earnings and the suspension of album production justified the termination of the members' exclusive contracts. item.description:
